## BrilliA Incorporated Filed Its Form 20-F on July 31, 2026


November 19, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/279274843/files/doc_news/BrilliA-Incorporated-Filed-Its-Form-20-F-on-July-31-2026-2026.pdf)


SINGAPORE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


BrilliA Incorporated (NYSE American: BRIA) (“BrilliA” or the “Company”) today announced, in accordance with Section 610(a) of the NYSE American Company Guide, that it filed its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on July 31, 2026.


The annual report, which contains the Company’s audited consolidated financial statements, can be accessed on the SEC’s website at[www.sec.gov](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov&esheet=54643653&newsitemid=20261119054251&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sec.gov&index=1&md5=10d92028d4cb4a36509d9cbc1ffe889e) and on the Company’s investor relations website at[https://brilliaincorporated.com/financials/sec-filings/default.aspx](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrilliaincorporated.com%2Ffinancials%2Fsec-filings%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54643653&newsitemid=20261119054251&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fbrilliaincorporated.com%2Ffinancials%2Fsec-filings%2Fdefault.aspx&index=2&md5=72d4d36529026e5da852ae801e3ba80a) .


Shareholders may request a hard copy of the Company’s complete audited financial statements free of charge by contacting the Company atinfo@brilliaincorporated.com .


**About BrilliA Incorporated**


BrilliA is a comprehensive one-stop service and solution provider for over 30 ladies’ intimate apparel brands worldwide, managing sourcing, design, prototyping, supply chain, logistics, and quality control. The Company works with major international companies, including Fruit of the Loom, HanesBrands Inc., Jockey and H&M. Through its Diana brand, BrilliA also designs and markets apparel for active lifestyles. Find out more at brilliaincorporated.com.
